correctness.rationale: For any positive T-periodic solution, integrate delayed predator recruitment over one period; time-shift invariance gives E(Gp)=e^{beta tau} pbar. Integrate the logistic prey equation to get pbar=sigma e^{-beta tau}[nbar(1−nbar/kappa)−Var(n)/kappa]. Nonconstant prey follows from strict monotonicity of fixed-n predation in p; then Var(n)>0 yields 0<nbar<kappa and strict pbar<sigma*kappa*exp(−beta*tau)/4. Saturation 0<G<1/h gives h exp(beta tau)<1 as a necessary condition. Checked algebra and saturation independently, and directly checked actual 2024 source delayed equations; the shift does not require tau/T rational.
